name: No Tool Calls Gate
description: Pass when the LLM produced no tool calls in the latest response, signaling that the agentic loop should terminate and the final assistant message should be returned. Fails (blocks) when tool calls are present, indicating another iteration is required.

inputs.name: has_tool_calls
inputs.description: Output of parse-tool-calls indicating whether tool calls are present

inputs.name: iteration
inputs.description: Current loop iteration count; used in log output only

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum iterations allowed; gate passes when this is reached regardless of has_tool_calls

outputs.name: terminate
outputs.description: True when the loop should stop
